method: composite (corridor_id, source_id) paired cluster bootstrap repeated once per training seed, each with that seed's test scores and validation-F1 thresholds; the same bootstrap random seed is used for every training seed, so all seeds are scored on identical cluster resamples and differences between seeds reflect model fitting only
interpretation_note: Bootstrap replicates are resamples of one fixed set of test senders, not independent experiments; they quantify sender-sampling uncertainty conditional on this scenario and do not replace training-seed variability.
verdict_definition: reference_better: 95% CI of (Transformer - model) above 0; reference_worse: CI below 0; inconclusive: CI contains 0
effect_size_note: Percentile intervals from a cluster bootstrap whose minority class is concentrated in relatively few sender clusters can be too narrow or biased when a small number of attacker clusters dominates a metric, and they condition on one fixed set of test senders. Seed-level effect sizes rest on few training seeds, so the standardized effect d_z (mean paired difference divided by its seed standard deviation) is imprecise and undefined when the paired difference has zero variance.
